title: Combat rogue at level 60 with Thistle Tea: uses it when its energy is spent

rules.desc: A level 60 Combat rogue that carries Thistle Tea uses it (the tea's spell is Restore Energy) within 5 s of an emptied bar, at least half the time
rules.source: ai/playerbot/strategy/rogue/RogueStrategy.cpp:88-90 (no energy available -> thistle tea at ACTION_HIGH + 5); ai/playerbot/strategy/triggers/GenericTriggers.h:65-74 (NoEnergyAvailableTrigger: energy under 20); ai/playerbot/strategy/actions/UseItemAction.h:402-412 (the action is useful only for a rogue of level 60 or more); TortoiseBots upstream/dev 0c56cf649
rules.why_expect: the runner empties the bar on a schedule (the TortoiseBots trigger is energy under 20); the tea's 5-min cooldown is reset each rep; the first answered drain ends the chances for 300 s (the responder cooldown)

rules.desc: Companion: the rogue deals damage to the mob at least 20 times a minute over the fight, so a rogue that drinks its tea and then stalls fails
rules.source: ai/playerbot/strategy/rogue/RogueStrategy.cpp:72-75 (the default combat action is melee at ACTION_IDLE); ai/playerbot/strategy/rogue/CombatRogueStrategy.cpp:12-45 (the ability rows, each gated on its own energy cost); ai/playerbot/strategy/triggers/GenericTriggers.cpp:316-319 (EnergyAvailable: an ability row waits for its energy); ai/playerbot/strategy/rogue/RogueStrategy.cpp:88-90 and ai/playerbot/strategy/actions/UseItemAction.h:402-412 (Thistle Tea answers an empty bar only at level 60 and above, so a level 40 rogue has no energy tool); TortoiseBots upstream/dev 0c56cf649
rules.why_expect: a 2 s swing alone is 30 events a minute

rules.desc: Precondition: Defensive Stance (aura 71) stays on the player through the fight
rules.source: precondition, no bot code: setup check player_stance proves the stance at the start, this uptime proves it in the fight
rules.why_expect: the stance is cast in set-up and nothing in the fight removes it; a repeat where it drops shows here instead of passing silently
